title: Consistent
summary: CONSISTENT, adjective [Latin See Consist.] 1. Fixed; firm; not fluid; as the consistent parts of a body, distinguished from the fluid. 2. Standing together or in agreement; compatible; congruous; unif

inlines.v: CONSISTENT, adjective [Latin See Consist.] 1. Fixed; firm; not fluid; as the consistent parts of a body, distinguished from the fluid. 2. Standing together or in agreement; compatible; congruous; uniform; not contradictory or opposed; as, two opinions or schemes are consistent; let a man be consistent with himself; the law is consistent with justice and policy. So two consistent motions act the soul
